sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for your offer and for your enthusiasm about working with us; we appreciate that reliable quality is important, and we’ll assess your quality commitment carefully. Our order volume is fixed at our full demand for this part over the term, all with Kalwisz, and the payment terms are fixed for this agreement. We understand that payment timing matters to you; is there anything you’d like us to clarify about the proposed terms?

We confirm a binding volume of 15900 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Electricity producer prices changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 45.15 (po:4500014429-10, po:4500014373-10, po:4500014306-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 41.36 per unit, 300 ppm, chargeback EUR 0 per complaint, for our full demand of 15900 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Hello,
thank you for your mail, we are very happy to hear from you!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
Please let me explain.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
Hi, thanks for the numbers. We saw the electricity drop and the volume bump, so we can do 46.00 EUR.
300 ppm is way too strict, but we can agree to 1500 ppm to help with the quality issues.
Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.00 per unit.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
We appreciate your move and understand that reliable cash flow matters to you; payment terms are fixed under this agreement and cannot change. In return, our binding volume is our full demand for this part over the contract term, all placed with you, and we are moving our proposal further toward you.

Payment is fixed at 60 days under this agreement and cannot be shortened.
We confirm a binding volume of 15900 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Your deliveries ran at 2376 ppm in 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 42.90 per unit, 300 ppm, chargeback EUR 0 per complaint, for our full demand of 15900 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
